headline: Premier League live updates: Leeds host Man United in rival clash
description: Leeds United take on Manchester United in one of England's most heated rivalries as another day of European soccer is underway.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Viktor Gyökeres leave Arsenal in January?
description: Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Chelsea's Emi Martínez has surgery, will be 'back in a few weeks'
description: Emi Martínez said he would be "back in a few weeks" after undergoing surgery following a head injury suffered during Chelsea's Premier League win over Everton on Saturday.

headline: Liverpool come from behind to beat shorthanded Brentford
description: Victor Muñoz and Alexander Isak take advantage of a weakened Brentford defence to score a pair of electric goals and lift Liverpool to a 2-1 comeback victory.

headline: Mikel Arteta: 'Big believer' Arsenal's Kai Havertz can score 30 goals a season
description: Mikel Arteta has said he is a "big believer" that Kai Havertz can be Arsenal's 30-goal-a-season man.

headline: Haaland, Man City hold off resilient Ipswich
description: Erling Haaland nets a double to extend his lead at the top of the goal-scoring tally as Manchester City take down Ipswich Town 3-2.
